QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Olivia: 'Find My Daddy'
QuestInfo.0: Those monsters have been defeated, but it looks like Olivia has something else to request.
QuestInfo.1: In order to find the right key to the Piano Room, you must first obtain #b25 Silver Keys, 25 Gold Keys, and 25 Brass Keys#k. Though it would be easier if you could just break that door open instead...
QuestInfo.2: You collected the #b25 Silver Keys, 25 Gold Keys, and 25 Brass Keys#k. But there's still more work to be done before you can relax.

0.0: I know I might be asking for a lot, but could you please go back inside and help escort my daddy out? He's stuck inside the Piano Room, and I believe one of the ghosts holds the key for entrance. Could you get me this key?

yes.0: I knew you'd do it! Hee hee. The only thing is, there are a bunch of keys around the house and I'm sure you'd have trouble finding the right one. So, could you look for #b25 Silver Keys, 25 Gold Keys, and 25 Brass Keys#k, then bring them back to me? I'll be able to look through them all and identify the correct key. And please hurry!

no.0: How can you tell me to 'suck it up' and go inside when you're afraid to go in yourself?

1.0: Please save my father who is confined in the Piano Room by finding the right set of keys. Were you able to find them yet?

yes.0: Oh, that's great! Now, let's see which one has just the right cut...

item.0: I was never too good at math, but I sure can count and it looks like you don't have enough yet. Please come back when you retrieve #b25 Silver Keys, 25 Gold Keys, and 25 Brass Keys#k.
